name: meuhedet_phase2_final_experiment_config
status: FROZEN for the real-data run (reviews/ASTRA_FINAL_RESOLUTION.md); any change requires a new review and a new freeze

outcome.label: Fall_Next_180D_Ind
outcome.note: Fall_Next_180D_Ind - EXPLORATORY 180-DAY OUTCOME, NOT EFALLS REPRODUCTION
outcome.predictor_record_rule: source_event_date < Index_Date (unchanged D-00 rule; never weakened)
outcome.death_rule: a recorded fall/fracture inside the window stays an event when death follows; death before any recorded event is a non-event; the warehouse label is audited on TRAIN+VALIDATION (label_death_audit) and the run stops (LABEL_DEATH_SEMANTICS) if deaths inside the window never carry an event (Astra F-05)
outcome.scope: exploratory prediction of recorded events in the D00_CLEAN selected cohort (Astra F-03)

data_split_policy.cohort: the reference meuhedet-explore D00_CLEAN cohort (age >= 65, one index date), rebuilt from the same extract and verified row-for-row and value-for-value against the reference dataset
data_split_policy.split: the reference patient-grouped split reproduced with the reference configuration; the TEST row-set sha256 must equal the reference; the assignment is cross-checked against the reference splits.csv
data_split_policy.patient_overlap: hard stop if any patient appears in more than one partition
data_split_policy.TRAIN: all feature screening, redundancy, encoding decisions, tuning, feature/model selection, stability, ablation, SHAP
data_split_policy.VALIDATION: sealed until SELECTION_FROZEN.json exists; opened ONCE (VALIDATION_OPENED.json) for a one-shot evaluation of the frozen configurations; never used to choose, tune, recalibrate or threshold anything
data_split_policy.TEST: identified during the split audit (count + sha256 only), dropped in memory before any other computation, never loaded again, never used by Phase 2

outer.grouped_by_patient: one row per patient (the cohort has one index date)

inner_linear.assignment: random permutation of patients (falls_ml.models.lasso_cv.assign_folds, grouped, not stratified)
inner_linear.used_for: lambda (LASSO) and (l1_ratio, lambda) (elastic net) by minimum mean held-out deviance

inner_xgboost.used_for: early stopping per inner fold (held-out log loss) and the Optuna objective (mean held-out log loss)

fitted_inside_every_fold: eFalls preprocessor incl. fractional-polynomial selection for age_years, polypharmacy_count_120d
cv_policy.common_inner_folds: one inner-fold assignment per tuning scope (outer<k> / final), shared by every feature set, lambda, l1_ratio and Optuna trial of that scope (Astra F-07); booster randomness keeps the item seed
cv_policy.conditionality: the inner lambda search is conditional on the outer-training-fold FP choice; OOF results are conditional on the TRAIN-wide label-blind decisions listed above (Astra F-07 / Q2)

seed_policy.item_seed: int(sha256(f'{seed}|{stage}|{item}')[:8], 16): independent of order and restarts
seed_policy.bootstrap_seed: the item seed of the stage item that computes it

threads.rule: auto = min(max_auto, os.cpu_count()); the resolved numbers are frozen in PHASE2_PLAN.json at the first start

provenance_policy.rule: the unchanged Phase 1 D-00 rules (falls_ml.d00.dependency._trace) on TRAIN + VALIDATION record dates; a feature takes the worst status of its inputs (UNSAFE > UNRESOLVED > SAFE)
provenance_policy.UNSAFE: excluded from every set ('candidate after DWH fix'); no row removal, no masking, no value replacement
provenance_policy.UNRESOLVED: EXPLORATORY_UNRESOLVED_SENSITIVITY only; never in a SAFE_DISCOVERY set (hard stop INELIGIBLE_FEATURE_IN_SET)

quarantine.Siudi_Status: nursing-care benefit status: code values unknown (Q-M-02)
quarantine.Customer_Risk_Code: member risk code: code semantics unknown
quarantine.Fall_Self_Report_Value: self-reported fall answer code: code semantics unknown
quarantine.On_Medications_Nurse_Ind: nurse medication item: which medications / threshold undocumented
quarantine.Orthostatic_BP_Measured_Ind: whether 1 = measured or 1 = abnormal is undocumented

HISTORICAL_BASELINE_15.definition: the previous benchmark: the 15 EXTENDED predictors with unchanged definitions (provenance as found), refitted in the Phase 2 protocol; comparison only

SAFE_DISCOVERY.definition: PRIMARY: new and baseline features whose prediction-time provenance is proven SAFE

EXPLORATORY_UNRESOLVED_SENSITIVITY.definition: separately labelled sensitivity; never a selection candidate; never UNSAFE

categories.reporting_rule: never mixed: separate tables / sections; every row carries its category

feature_set_definitions.SAFE_BASE: the BASELINE_15 predictors whose D-00 status is SAFE
feature_set_definitions.EFALLS_MAPPABLE_SAFE: SAFE_BASE + SAFE non-redundant features with an eFalls mapping class
feature_set_definitions.ALL_REVIEWED_SAFE: SAFE_BASE + every SAFE non-redundant feature (= the last SAFE waterfall step = ALL_SAFE_LINEAR)
feature_set_definitions.ALL_REVIEWED_SAFE_WITHOUT_EXPLICIT_ASSES: ALL_REVIEWED_SAFE without the explicit form 'assessed' indicators (sensitivity; other NULL indicators stay, so missingness can still carry assessment information)
feature_set_definitions.SAFE_BASE_PLUS_<DOMAIN>: SAFE_BASE + every SAFE feature of one domain (one-domain addition, not pruned)
feature_set_definitions.SAFE_WATERFALL_<k>_<DOMAIN>: cumulative SAFE steps in the declared order: COGNITION -> MEDICATION -> FRAILTY -> FUNCTION_MOBILITY -> UTILISATION -> HOME_ENVIRONMENT -> OTHER_NATIVE
feature_set_definitions.ALL_REVIEWED_SAFE_MINUS_<DOMAIN>: ALL_REVIEWED_SAFE without one domain (leave-one-domain-out, fully nested)
feature_set_definitions.EXPLORATORY_B15_PLUS_SAFE: BASELINE_15 (incl. its UNRESOLVED predictors) + every SAFE non-redundant feature (exploratory)
feature_set_definitions.EXPLORATORY_ALL_REVIEWED: BASELINE_15 + every SAFE or UNRESOLVED non-redundant feature (exploratory)
feature_set_definitions.forms_rule: a set with an item of an assessment form also holds that form's 'assessed' indicator (not measured != negative)
feature_set_definitions.aliases: identical specifications share one fit (recorded in FEATURE_SETS.json)

linear.binary: 1 if positive else 0; NULL covered by the form indicator, else an na__ indicator
linear.ordinal: thermometer dummies (>= level) for the declared levels present on TRAIN
linear.count_days_amount: log1p; NULL -> fold median + na__ indicator
linear.fall_recency_bands: days since last fall: <= 90, 91-180, 181-365, > 365 (reference: no prior fall)
linear.baseline_block: unchanged eFalls preprocessor (efalls_fp_all_levels; FP selection for age / polypharmacy inside each fold)
linear.standardisation: z-score of every design column on the fitting rows (inside the solver); coefficients reported on both scales
linear.duplicate_columns: exact duplicate design columns dropped inside each fold (first kept, recorded)

encoding_policy.trees: raw engineered values, NULL kept (native missing-value routing); sex -> female 0/1; form indicators included; no scaling, no log, no thermometer, no imputation

redundancy.rule: representative-anchored; representative = baseline feature, else lowest missingness, then catalogue order

LASSO.penalty: L1 on standardised coefficients; intercept unpenalised
LASSO.solver: proximal-Newton (IRLS) + covariance-mode cyclic coordinate descent, warm starts along the lambda path

selection.objective: minimum mean held-out deviance (= 2 x log loss) over the inner folds

LASSO.convergence_retry: policy v1: one retry with a 10x full-path iteration limit at the same lambda*; never accepted unconverged

ELASTIC_NET.implementation: falls_ml.phase2.enet.ElasticNetLogisticCV (glmnet parameterisation, same solver; = LASSO at l1_ratio 1)
ELASTIC_NET.selection: joint (l1_ratio, lambda) by minimum inner-CV mean deviance
ELASTIC_NET.sets: ALL_REVIEWED_SAFE + the best SAFE LASSO set by outer-OOF AP (max 2)

XGBOOST.base_score_note: auto = estimated by xgboost from the fitting rows' labels (not passed)
XGBOOST.early_stopping: xgb.train(num_boost_round=ceiling, evals=[inner held-out fold], early_stopping_rounds); the inner held-out fold is scored with iteration_range=(0, best_iteration+1) (the native API returns the LAST model); the final fit of a scope = median inner best iteration + 1 trees on all its training rows, WITHOUT early stopping; outer held-out rows never seen (Astra F-01)

stage2.depth_rule: {best-1, best, best+1} intersected with the stage-1 range (never 0)
stage2.condition: stage-1 outer-OOF AP >= best SAFE linear outer-OOF AP + 0.005
stage2.local_space: max_depth +/-1 and min_child_weight / reg_lambda within best/factor..best*factor of the scope's stage-1 best (clipped to the stage-1 range)

XGBOOST.deterministic: hist on CPU with a fixed thread count and seed (checked bit-for-bit by the preflight self-test)

optuna.failure_handling: a trial is a committed item; an interrupted trial leaves no trace (study rebuilt from committed trials); a trial error stops the run (no silent FAIL state)
optuna.promotion_metric: stage 1 -> stage 2 and XGBoost vs linear: outer-OOF AP (never VALIDATION)

selection.rule: a SAFE_DISCOVERY candidate (kinds main, domain_add, waterfall; families LASSO / ENET / XGBOOST) qualifies vs LASSO:SAFE_BASE if ALL of: dAP >= min_delta_ap, d capture@principal >= min_delta_capture_principal_pp, log loss <= max_logloss_ratio x reference, OOF calibration slope within calibration_slope_range and |CITL| <= max_abs_citl; recommended = the simplest (linear before XGBoost, then fewer features used) within simplicity_margin_ap of the best qualifying OOF AP, else LASSO:SAFE_BASE. The recommended model is then classified vs LASSO:BASELINE_15: SUPERIOR (meets the same rule), NON_INFERIOR (dAP >= -max_ap_loss and d capture >= -max_capture_loss_pp), else INFERIOR. Frozen in SELECTION_FROZEN.json before VALIDATION is opened.
selection.benchmark_class_kind: point-estimate classification, not a formal superiority / non-inferiority test (Astra F-03)
selection.benchmark_identity: LASSO:BASELINE_15 = the 15 historical predictors refitted on TRAIN in the Phase 2 protocol, no recalibration; not the Phase 1 model recalibrated on VALIDATION (Astra F-02)
selection.no_selection_outcome: NO_INCREMENTAL_MODEL_SELECTED (SAFE_BASE is reported, never self-compared; Astra F-08)
selection.undefined_values: an undefined (NaN) quantity never passes a rule (Astra F-08)

attribution_contrasts.MODEL_FAMILY_PIPELINE: XGB_TUNED:ALL_REVIEWED_SAFE vs the TRAIN-selected best linear model on ALL_REVIEWED_SAFE
attribution_contrasts.note: frozen before VALIDATION; paired intervals on OOF and VALIDATION; no extra fits (Astra F-09)

selection.shortlist: LASSO:SAFE_BASE, LASSO:BASELINE_15, the recommended model, then the best SAFE candidate of each other family (<= max_challengers)

validation.rule: one-shot exploratory screen on reused VALIDATION: recommended vs SAFE_BASE -> CONFIRMED_PROMISING if dAP >= min_delta_ap, d capture@principal >= min pp, log loss <= max_logloss_ratio x SAFE_BASE and calibration within range (NaN never passes), else NOT_CONFIRMED; point-estimate class vs the BASELINE_15 refit with the same superiority margins and the non-inferiority margins; every frozen configuration is also scored descriptively on the same rows

metrics.primary: average precision (AP = PR-AUC, step-wise, sklearn-equivalent, ties grouped)
secondary: log loss (proper scoring rule; tuning objective and safeguard)
scaled Brier (1 - Brier / Brier of the prevalence)
calibration intercept and slope (logistic recalibration of the logit)
metrics.capacity_rule: ceil(capacity x n) highest risks; ties keep row order; identical rule for every model on the same rows

paired_bootstrap.per_capacity: difference in recorded events identified at every capacity, also per 10,000 comparable D00_CLEAN patients (Astra F-12)
paired_bootstrap.note: describes sampling variation of frozen predictions; does not account for the model search

definitions.scaled_brier: 1 - Brier / [p_eval (1 - p_eval)], p_eval = prevalence of the evaluated rows
definitions.citl: a in logit P(y=1) = a + 1 x logit(p) (offset)

calibration_policy.no_recalibration: no model is recalibrated in Phase 2 (no calibration data independent of VALIDATION exists)
calibration_policy.evaluated: every configuration: CITL, slope, intercept, O:E, Brier, scaled Brier (OOF and VALIDATION); for the shortlist and the management waterfall: bootstrap intervals of these indices and a smooth calibration curve (restricted cubic spline of logit(p), 95% band) with decile points (Astra F-11)
calibration_policy.class_weighting: none, so predicted probabilities stay on the risk scale

stability.method: LASSO on bootstrap resamples of TRAIN (inner CV repeated, copies of a resampled patient kept in one inner fold); selection count, frequency with Monte Carlo SE, sign consistency; LASSO only - never certifies elastic-net-only or XGBoost findings (Astra F-13)
stability.sets: finalists only: SAFE linear shortlist sets, ALL_REVIEWED_SAFE, then BASELINE_15 (max_sets)
stability.feature_selected: any of its encoded design columns non-zero

ablation.leave_one_domain_out: LASSO, fully nested (retuned), vs LASSO:ALL_REVIEWED_SAFE on the same outer folds
ablation.individual: top-N new features of the recommended SAFE model (or the best SAFE model with new features) by final-model importance, refitted without the feature with the fold's frozen hyper-parameters (explanatory)

explainability.target: the XGBoost member of the frozen shortlist (if any)
explainability.permutation: per outer fold, on that fold's held-out rows, with that fold's booster; delta AP and delta log loss
explainability.shap: TreeSHAP (pred_contribs) of the final booster on a class-stratified TRAIN sample; aggregated quantiles only (no per-patient points leave the PC)

consensus.label: exploratory predictive evidence (not causal)
consensus.classes: U univariate; L = LASSO selection with LASSO stability >= linear_min_stability; I = SHAP rank <= shap_top_rank of the promoted XGBoost; permutation gain > 0 alone and elastic-net-only selection = weak support; A_dom one-domain gain >= domain_min_delta_ap; A_feat individual ablation >= ablation_min_delta_ap
consensus.ratings: STRONG = A_feat and (L or I); MODERATE = (L or I) and (U or A_dom), or A_feat; WEAK = any single support; NONE

investigation.LABEL_DEATH_SEMANTICS: deaths inside the 180-day window (>= 50) never carry a recorded event (possible overwrite of prior events by death; Astra F-05)
investigation.SINGLE_FEATURE_DOMINANCE: a new feature with TRAIN univariate AUROC >= 0.8 (or its mirror)
investigation.IMPLAUSIBLE_GAIN_OOF: any SAFE / exploratory configuration vs BASELINE_15 on TRAIN OOF: dAUROC > 0.05 or AP ratio > 1.5
investigation.IMPLAUSIBLE_CALIBRATION_OOF: recommended model OOF slope outside [0.6, 1.5] or |CITL| > 0.5
investigation.PROXY_DOMINANCE: one new feature > 50% of mean |SHAP| or of the permutation AP loss of the promoted XGBoost
investigation.IMPLAUSIBLE_GAIN_VALIDATION: same limits as the OOF gate, on VALIDATION
investigation.IMPLAUSIBLE_CALIBRATION_VALIDATION: a shortlist model's VALIDATION calibration outside the gate range

compute_budget.lasso_fits_per_set: 5 outer + 1 final, each with a 10-fold path CV
compute_budget.enet_fits: <= 2 sets x 6 fits x 3 l1_ratios x 10-fold path CV
compute_budget.xgb_stage0_fits: 2 sets x 6 scopes x (5 inner + 1 final)
